specific_decisions.aspirated_stops: Explicit source digraphs map to house superscript aspiration.
specific_decisions.underlined_ts: ʦ; original lower lines remain in Original and source audit.
specific_decisions.w: v under the volume key’s v/w spelling alternatives; Original retains w.
specific_decisions.vowels: Preserve printed length and nasalization, including combined macron plus tilde.
specific_decisions.retroflexes: Preserve source underdots; do not conflate dotted ṭs with underlined ts.
specific_decisions.punctuation: Terminal period/question mark omitted only from display conversion; source Form/Original retained.
